selection.scope: One authentic decode down-projection geometry on four A76 cores: M=1,K=10240,N=2560, FP16 activation and row-major FP16 weights, FP32 accumulation/output. Measure one full-matrix invocation and derive, but do not measure, a 42-call projection.

ope0_bandwidth_ceiling.evidence_limit: Single formal OPE0 segment; owner waived replication.

semantic_contract.operation: For each output row n: y[n] = sum over k of float32(fp16(x[k])) * float32(fp16(w[n,k])).
semantic_contract.reduction_order: Implementations may reassociate the reduction only within the frozen elementwise tolerance.
semantic_contract.deployment_limit: Only M/K/N and call frequency are deployment-authentic. FP16 CPU execution and row-major storage are cross-ISA comparator choices, not assertions about the closed W8A8 carrier.

formal_shape.output_partition: Four fixed contiguous N/4=640-row partitions, one per pinned A76 worker; all variants use the same partition and synchronization path.

analytic_account.interpretation: One FP16 call traverses a complete 52.4 MB matrix. The 42-call number is an arithmetic counterfactual with the same shape repeated, not a measured population and not 42 distinct layer weights.

scalar_fp32.implementation: Four pinned workers with identical output partitioning; scalar FP32 multiply-accumulate inner loop with function-scoped vectorization disabled.

autovec_o3.implementation: The same four-worker semantic loop compiled with -O3 -mcpu=cortex-a76 and normal GCC auto-vectorization; retain vectorization diagnostics and disassembly, but vectorization is not a validity requirement.

neon_fp16_f32acc.implementation: Explicit AArch64 NEON eight-half loads, low/high FP16-to-FP32 conversion, and independent FP32 FMA accumulators; horizontal reduction produces one FP32 output. FP16 FMLAL is not required.

correctness_protocol.oracle: Independent FP64 scalar reference, outside every timed region.

input_distributions.definition: Activation and weight values are FP16-exact multiples of 0.25 in [-2,2].
input_distributions.reason: Products and the bounded K=10240 sum are exactly representable in FP32, so this corpus detects semantic or indexing errors without a tolerance escape.

input_distributions.definition: Independent N(0,1) values clipped to [-3,3] and cast to FP16.
Independent N(0,4) values clipped to [-8,8] and cast to FP16.

structural_assertions: output shape and contiguous layout match
activation and weight buffers are byte-identical before and after every implementation
all workers cover disjoint row ranges whose union is [0,2560)
correctness_protocol.repair_kill: After three candidate correctness repair iterations, stop and retain the failing corpus. Harness-only faults may be fixed only with an explicit attempt receipt before formal timing.

implementation_identity.source_lock_rule: These files do not exist at preregistration freeze. Before formal execution, hash all three plus this preregistration and the scope file into a source-lock receipt. Any later content change requires a transparent preregistration revision before another run.
codegen_gates: scalar_fp32 disassembly must not contain vector floating-point multiply-accumulate in its inner kernel
neon_fp16_f32acc disassembly must show FP16-to-FP32 vector conversion and FP32 vector FMA instructions
autovec_o3 vectorization diagnostics and disassembly are retained, but lack of auto-vectorization does not invalidate the baseline

measurement_protocol.thread_affinity: Worker i is pinned to CPU 4+i before correctness and remains fixed for all variants.
measurement_protocol.working_set: One immutable 52,428,800-byte FP16 weight matrix, one 20,480-byte FP16 activation, and separate FP32 outputs. Every invocation traverses the complete matrix; no reduced-size cache proxy and no 42-matrix allocation.
measurement_protocol.interleave: Use all six permutations of scalar_fp32/autovec_o3/neon_fp16_f32acc in round-robin blocks until every variant independently satisfies both the repetition and time minima.
measurement_protocol.frequency_gate: Every timed-window sample for policy4 and policy6 must be at least 95% of that policy's recorded max frequency.
measurement_protocol.thermal_gate: No timed-window thermal sample may equal or exceed the lowest enabled trip point recorded for its zone.
measurement_protocol.stability_gate: IQR/p50 must be <=0.30 for all three variants. Instability invalidates the only formal segment; no automatic retry is authorized.
measurement_protocol.owner_instruction: 不需要复测，取消同日复测，只测一次
measurement_protocol.controller_clock: Record controller timestamps immediately before and after the board process; use board CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW for durations.
measurement_protocol.smoke_policy: No separate performance smoke, no reduced-shape timing, and no second formal segment. Randomized correctness is the only pre-timing execution gate.
measurement_protocol.failure_policy: A failed correctness, codegen, affinity, frequency, thermal, stability, perf-event, source-lock, or governor-restore gate yields a bounded invalid single-segment receipt. Do not silently rerun or change the shape.

tier_a.scope: Report each variant per call. Only the candidate receives the explicit 42-call counterfactual projection.

tier_b.scope: Collect once per variant after valid timing using repeated full invocations in the same single formal segment.
tier_b.bus_access_policy: Preserve the OPE3 rejection of bus_access count*64. Report count*8 only as a transferred-beat hypothesis diagnostic; it is not an analytic-byte acceptance gate.
tier_b.required_gate: All four named events must be numeric for all three variants; no raw-event substitution or post-measurement normalization.
tier_b.perf_record: Not required; this stage asks a same-shape dtype/ISA timing question, not a new symbol-hotspot question.

ope3_a76_int8.lineage: OPE3 int8 row-major [N,K], four A76 cores, neon_sdot
ope3_a76_int8.use: Primary same-geometry CPU anchor. Report candidate p50/int8 p50 together with the 1.999609679937549 analytic-byte ratio; do not interpret the latency ratio as a pure dtype causal effect.

ope2_npu_fp16.lineage: OPE2 rknn_matmul_run core0 normal-layout FP16 primitive
ope2_npu_fp16.use: Reused context only; do not rerun and do not construct a hardware leaderboard.

ope4.metric: C02 aggregate consecutive NORMAL callback interval
ope4.use: Denominator for a counterfactual isolated 42-call ratio only; no component attribution or subtraction from TPOT.

outcome_rules.measurement_valid: Scope/prereg/source-lock hashes, 69120 element comparisons, codegen, three timing populations, affinity, telemetry, governor restoration, all named perf events, and the one-segment identity must pass.
outcome_rules.cpu_dtype_path_ratio: candidate_fp16_p50_us / 944.7080005; always co-report the 1.999609679937549 analytic-byte ratio and all lineage differences.
outcome_rules.major_gap_claim_prohibited: No isolated result may be attributed to the OPE4 gap without a new carrier proving equivalent FP16 GEMV work is dispatched to CPU in the closed runtime.
outcome_rules.time_kill: Stop and write a bounded result if implementation plus the one formal segment exceeds two working days.

claim_limits: This protocol is frozen before candidate implementation and before any OPE5-02 board execution.
Only geometry and frequency are deployment-authentic; CPU FP16 dtype, row-major layout, and execution are isolated comparator choices.
The 42-call result is a p50 multiplication, not a measured full linear population, not 42 distinct layer weights, and not RKLLM component time.
OPE2 NPU FP16, OPE3 A76 int8, OPE4 model-stage, and any PC row remain lineage-separated and are not a hardware leaderboard.
OPE3 bus_access*64 remains rejected; count*8 is a diagnostic hypothesis only.
One formal segment is authorized; replication remains explicitly unsatisfied and no same-day retest or instability retry is scheduled.
No gate/up shape, prefill, A55 lane, NPU rerun, RKLLM model run, quality evaluation, driver/kernel/shared-library change, or frozen artifact mutation is authorized.
